cohort: 624 postnatal mothers in their first year after childbirth residing in the West Arsi zone, Ethiopia.
finding: The prevalence of postpartum post-traumatic stress disorder among postnatal mothers in West Arsi zone, Ethiopia, was 21.60%.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery and instrumental delivery were significantly associated with an increased likelihood of postpartum post-traumatic stress disorder.
cross-section timing: within the first year after childbirth
